title: rosa × andegavensis var. superba
intro: Rosa × andegavensis var. superba, commonly known as Andean rose or Andes rose, is a hybrid rose species native to the Andean region. The health benefits of Rosa × andegavensis var. superba include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine for its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its potential application in the treatment of skin conditions and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Rosa × andegavensis var. superba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
